sloka: रामहस्ताद्दशग्रीवः शूरो दत्तमहावरः।इदं भयं महाघोरमुत्पन्नं नावबुध्यते ।। ६.९५.२६ ।।
transliteration: rāmahastāddaśagrīvaḥ śūro dattamahāvaraḥ।idaṁ bhayaṁ mahāghoramutpannaṁ nāvabudhyate ।। 6.95.26 ।।

translations.english: "Eminent heroes killed by Rama, hopes of life lost, not able to see the end of fear, we are like orphans weeping."
